speaker: Doctor
text: That's unusual; please tell me, did you experience any pain in your sides or back, along with fever, after finishing your antibiotics for the sinusitis? Also, have you noticed any changes in your urine, such as blood or cloudiness?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since your urine changes are not fully described, please tell me if your urine appears cloudy, has a strong odor, or if you have noticed visible blood. Additionally, did you develop any burning sensation during urination or frequent urges to void?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis secondary to antibiotic-induced C. difficile colitis (suspected based on rash, antibiotic change, and classic UTI symptoms) or simply Pyelonephritis with drug hypersensitivity. REQUEST IMAGES: Ultrasound of the Kidneys and Bladder.
